nodes.label: Postmortem template
nodes.rationale: Blameless incident postmortem: focus on systems and contributing factors, never individuals; action items are specific, assignable, and tagged Prevent/Detect/Mitigate.

nodes.label: Keep a Changelog
nodes.rationale: External standard governing the default changelog header format, used only when creating CHANGELOG.md fresh; an existing file's own convention always wins.

nodes.label: Frontend Design skill
nodes.rationale: Deliberate, opinionated visual design as a design lead: make choices specific to the brief, avoid three recognizable AI default looks, spend boldness in one signature element and keep the rest disciplined.

nodes.label: Design token system
nodes.rationale: Compact token system with color, type, layout, and a single signature element is the design plan reviewed against the brief before any code is written.

nodes.label: Design lead role
nodes.rationale: Adopt the persona of a small studio design lead who gives each client a visual identity that could not be mistaken for anyone else's, rejecting templated proposals.

nodes.label: Scope skill
nodes.rationale: Turns an idea into an ordered, coarse, living plan in docs/scope/ and keeps it honest as the product ships; seeds WHAT to build while /architect designs and /develop builds.

nodes.label: Build approach: Tracer Bullet
nodes.rationale: Prove the whole pipe works before building any part of it fully; the thinnest real thread through every layer, no fakes or stubs, thicken each segment later.

nodes.label: Build approach: Skateboard
nodes.rationale: Ship the smallest complete product a real person would actually use, then grow it; cut structure (teams, roles) when not needed to be usable day one.

nodes.label: Build approach: Facade
nodes.rationale: UI first, clickable and believable on fake data, then wire the real backend behind it; prototype grade on purpose until wired.

nodes.label: Build approach: Journey
nodes.rationale: Deliver one complete user journey, all its states and polish, fully, before starting the next; depth first per journey, not breadth across everything.

nodes.label: Build approach concept
nodes.rationale: Build approach decides how every feature is sliced and sequenced, recorded in the scope header and persisted to AGENTS.md; default Tracer Bullet for production builds, shifted by the product goal.

nodes.label: Workflow tier
nodes.rationale: One rigor dial per feature (Prototype/Alpha/Beta/GA) driving design time, the verification tail after /develop, and what closes done; per feature tag overrides the project default.

nodes.label: Feature lifecycle
nodes.rationale: planned -> in-progress -> done, plus existing (predates the workflow) and dropped (de-scoped, kept for history); /develop, /check verify, /test, and /sync advance it.

nodes.label: Scope mode: replan
nodes.rationale: The living rhythm: run after a feature or phase ships, reconcile what shipped, surface assumed decision debt, enroll needs from build feedback, and queue the next slice.

nodes.label: Foundations first sequencing
nodes.rationale: No approach starts a feature slice before the ground it stands on exists; lead with stack, tooling, data model, design system, and a working skeleton before feature work.

nodes.label: Sync skill
nodes.rationale: Closes the loop on a completed change by reconciling AGENTS.md files, the scope, and spec Status lines to what the repo shows; surgical edits only, never whole sections or curated prose.

nodes.label: Decision panel
nodes.rationale: Every user facing choice presented as an options panel with 2 to 4 concrete options, exactly one marked recommended with a one line why, letting the engineer override.
